# Dota myth library

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_myths_doc.py from evals/myths.yaml; do not edit by hand -->

17 popular beliefs, each tested with one dota-insights tool call against https://dota-insights.vercel.app/mcp on 2026-11-04. 7 supported, 5 not supported, 5 inconclusive.

How to read a verdict:

- **Supported** means the data shows the association the claim states, with a 95% interval that excludes no effect. It never means the condition causes the win: every result here is observational, and most of these metrics are partly a result of winning (a team that is ahead buys items sooner, takes more objectives and runes).
- **Not supported** means the data does not show the claimed effect (or shows the opposite). That is not proof there is no effect, only that it is not visible at this sample size.
- **Inconclusive** means the sample is too small, the interval is too wide, or the tool cannot separate the claim from the game state behind it.

Most tests run on parsed league matches from OpenDota's explorer (pro and amateur leagues), the only bulk source of per-player stats and purchase logs; pub numbers may differ. Each myth is also an eval case in `evals/dataset.toml` (column *Eval*).

<a id="bkb-timing-pa"></a>

## BKB timing decides Phantom Assassin games.

**Supported (association).** +23.2 pp win rate (74.4% of 43 vs 51.2% of 166); n = 209, 95% CI 0.068 to 0.363, p = 0.0063. Patch 7.40, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
test_hypothesis({"hero": "PA", "group_a": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "bkb", "op": "<", "value": 20}], "group_b": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "bkb", "op": ">=", "value": 20}], "filters": {"patch": "7.40"}})
```

- 7.41 has only 94 parsed league PA games with a BKB (11 before 20 min), below the tool's minimum, so the run uses 7.40.
- A PA that is already winning gets BKB sooner; the timing is as much a symptom of a good game as a cause.
- Games that end before 20 minutes cannot have a late BKB, and very long games are all in group B.

<a id="first-blood"></a>

## The team that draws first blood wins the game.

**Inconclusive.** first-blood team wins 54.2% (271 of 500), +4.2 pp over a coin flip; n = 500, 95% CI 0.498 to 0.585, p = 0.06. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, newest parsed league matches.

```
get_objective_impact({})
```

- The interval touches 50%; at most a small edge, not a predictor of the result.
- The tool's when_even split is meaningless for first blood: the lead at the first kill is ~0 in every game, so when_even equals the overall rate.
- League games only; pub first bloods (often a smoke at the rune) may differ.

<a id="wards-supports"></a>

## Supports who place more wards win more.

**Not supported.** Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio 0.95 (above vs at-or-below median observers, duration strata); n = 500, 95% CI 0.663 to 1.36, p = 0.86. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
analyze_correlation({"metric": "wards", "hero": "Lion"})
```

- Pooled over every player (3,000 rows) the odds ratio is 0.99 (0.85-1.14, p = 0.88): no association either.
- Ward count says nothing about ward placement; a losing team also wards more defensively.
- One hero (Lion) as a support stand-in; other supports were not run.

<a id="roshan-early"></a>

## Killing Roshan before 20 minutes wins games.

**Inconclusive.** first-Roshan team wins 79.2% overall, 57.3% when the gold lead at the kill was within ±2,000 (55 of 96); n = 451, 95% CI 0.473 to 0.667, p = 3.2e-35. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, newest parsed league matches.

```
get_objective_impact({})
```

- The CI and verdict are for the even-game rate; the p-value is for the overall 79.2%.
- No tool splits Roshan by kill time yet, so 'before 20 minutes' itself is untested; this is first Roshan at any time.
- The median first-Roshan team is 4,716 gold ahead at the kill: most of the 79% is the lead that made the Roshan possible.

<a id="first-tower"></a>

## Losing the first tower decides the game.

**Supported (association).** first-tower team wins 62.8%; 58.3% when within ±2,000 gold at the time (215 of 369); n = 500, 95% CI 0.532 to 0.632, p = 1e-08. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, newest parsed league matches.

```
get_objective_impact({})
```

- CI is for the even-game rate. 'Decides' overstates it: four games in ten are still won by the other team.
- A building counts for the side that did not own it, also when creeps finished it.

<a id="tormentor"></a>

## The first Tormentor is a waste of time.

**Not supported.** first-Tormentor team wins 74.3%; 65.5% when within ±2,000 gold (38 of 58); n = 230, 95% CI 0.527 to 0.764, p = 1.5e-13. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, newest parsed league matches.

```
get_objective_impact({})
```

- CI is for the even-game rate, the strongest even-game edge of any objective in the run.
- Only 230 of 500 matches had a Tormentor kill; teams that go for it may be the more organised ones.

<a id="two-roshans"></a>

## Two Roshans in a row means the game is over.

**Inconclusive.** double-Roshan team wins 87.5%; 58.8% when within ±2,000 gold (10 of 17); n = 184, 95% CI 0.36 to 0.784, p = 2.6e-24. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, newest parsed league matches.

```
get_objective_impact({})
```

- 87.5% overall, but the median double-Roshan team leads by 11,527 gold; with only 17 even games nothing can be said about the Roshans themselves.

<a id="rune-control"></a>

## Mid rune control wins games.

**Inconclusive.** team with more power runes wins 82.6%; n = 472, 95% CI 0.789 to 0.858, p = 1.3e-45. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, newest parsed league matches.

```
get_objective_impact({})
```

- Runes are counted over the whole match, so the winning team controls the map and picks up more runes late; the tool has no early-game rune split, so cause and symptom cannot be separated.

<a id="stacking"></a>

## Stacking camps wins games.

**Not supported.** odds ratio 1.11 (above vs at-or-below median stacks, duration strata); n = 3,000, 95% CI 0.96 to 1.29, p = 0.17. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
analyze_correlation({"metric": "stacks"})
```

- All heroes and roles pooled; the median player stacks 2 camps, so the split is coarse.
- In games under 25 minutes the high-stack half wins 61% vs 45%, but that stratum has only 170 rows.

<a id="farm-wins"></a>

## The team with the higher-GPM carry always wins.

**Supported (association).** odds ratio 2.10 (above vs at-or-below median GPM, duration strata); n = 3,000, 95% CI 1.82 to 2.43, p = < 1e-15. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
analyze_correlation({"metric": "gpm"})
```

- Selection bias: winning teams farm more because they are winning; GPM is mostly a result.
- 'Always' is wrong: within 35-45 minute games the higher-GPM half still loses 41% of the time.

<a id="kills-dont-matter"></a>

## Kills don't win games, only objectives do.

**Not supported.** odds ratio 4.04 for kills vs 4.77 for tower damage (run with metric tower_damage); n = 3,000, 95% CI 3.47 to 4.7, p = < 1e-15. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
analyze_correlation({"metric": "kills"})
```

- Kills are about as strongly tied to winning as building damage (tower_damage OR 4.77, CI 4.09-5.56); both are outcomes of a winning game as much as causes.
- The kill association fades in long games (stratum r 0.56 under 25 min, 0.24 after 45).

<a id="hero-damage"></a>

## The player with the most hero damage carried the game.

**Supported (association).** odds ratio 2.29; n = 3,000, 95% CI 1.98 to 2.65, p = < 1e-15. Patch 7.41, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
analyze_correlation({"metric": "hero_damage"})
```

- The association is strong in short games (r 0.39) and weak after 45 minutes (r 0.10), where the losing side also deals plenty of damage.
- Roles pooled: cores deal more damage than supports regardless of the result.

<a id="radiant-advantage"></a>

## Radiant wins more than Dire.

**Supported (association).** Radiant wins 52.96% of ranked All Pick games; n = 252,862, 95% CI 0.528 to 0.532, p = —. Patch 7.41, OpenDota public matches, latest ~11 hours (2026-11-04 10:36-20:10 UTC).

```
get_general_stats({})
```

- A ~3-point side edge in pubs, measured over one ~11-hour window; it leans towards the regions in prime time then (49% Russia).
- In league games the side edge was not visible for Lion (47.9% vs 48.1%, n = 500, test_hypothesis side == radiant); league drafts may compensate.

<a id="battle-fury-am"></a>

## A sub-15-minute Battle Fury is what makes Anti-Mage win.

**Supported (association).** +17.8 pp win rate (50.4% of 129 vs 32.6% of 89); n = 218, 95% CI 0.045 to 0.301, p = 0.0091. Patch 7.40, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
test_hypothesis({"hero": "Anti-Mage", "group_a": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "battle fury", "op": "<", "value": 15}], "group_b": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "battle fury", "op": ">=", "value": 15}], "filters": {"patch": "7.40"}})
```

- A free lane gives both the fast Battle Fury and the win; a contested lane delays both.
- Even the fast group only wins half its games.

<a id="blink-axe"></a>

## Axe needs Blink Dagger before 13 minutes or he loses.

**Not supported.** +9.1 pp win rate (56.8% of 81 vs 47.7% of 386); n = 467, 95% CI -0.028 to 0.205, p = 0.14. Patch 7.40, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
test_hypothesis({"hero": "Axe", "group_a": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "blink dagger", "op": "<", "value": 13}], "group_b": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "blink dagger", "op": ">=", "value": 13}], "filters": {"patch": "7.40"}})
```

- Not shown is not disproven: the interval allows anything from -3 to +20 points.
- Only 81 of 467 league Axes had Blink before 13 minutes.

<a id="spectre-late"></a>

## Spectre wins if the game goes late.

**Supported (association).** +31.0 pp win rate (69.7% of 33 vs 38.7% of 225); n = 258, 95% CI 0.128 to 0.453, p = 0.00076. Patch 7.39, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
test_hypothesis({"hero": "Spectre", "group_a": [{"field": "duration_min", "op": ">=", "value": 45}], "group_b": [{"field": "duration_min", "op": "<", "value": 45}], "filters": {"patch": "7.39"}})
```

- 7.40 and 7.41 have too few parsed league Spectre games past 45 minutes (4 on 7.40), so the run uses 7.39.
- Duration is not chosen: a game goes long partly because Spectre's team is holding on, which is the same story read backwards.

<a id="midas"></a>

## Hand of Midas on Nature's Prophet loses games.

**Inconclusive.** not computed: only 4 of 319 league Nature's Prophets bought Midas; n = 319, 95% CI —, p = —. Patch 7.40, OpenDota explorer, parsed league matches.

```
test_hypothesis({"hero": "Nature's Prophet", "group_a": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "hand of midas", "op": "bought"}], "group_b": [{"field": "item_minute", "item": "hand of midas", "op": "not_bought"}], "filters": {"patch": "7.40"}})
```

- League players almost never build it, so league data cannot answer this; a pub source with purchase logs (the collector's STRATZ-enriched matches) would be needed.
